references.text: Describes the same geographical areas in the promised land: the mountains, the lowlands, the Arabah, and the Negev.
Mentions the same seven nations that lived in Canaan: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
God's promise to deliver Israel from a land inhabited by these nations: the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
The Lord's angel will lead Israel and drive out the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Command to devote these peoples to destruction: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
The kings in the mountains, the lowlands, and along the coast gathered against Israel—including the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Describes the same nations in various geographical areas that were defeated by Joshua.
Joshua conquered the whole land: the mountains, the Negev, the lowlands, and the hills—all the same geographical areas.
The spies' report on the peoples living in the Negev, the mountains, and other areas of Canaan.
